a_rho_by_format.inputs: SemEval binary F1 per checkpoint from results/revision/post8/e9.json tiers A (and C-auto as a sensitivity); within-drug AUROC per checkpoint from results/revision/amend7/e9.json e9.panel (tier A) and from post8/e9.json tier C-auto
a_rho_by_format.interval: percentile bootstrap over checkpoints within the stratum, 10000 draws, numpy RandomState(42); draws where either vector is constant are dropped and counted
a_rho_by_format.also: two-sided permutation p over 10000 random permutations of AUROC against F1, RandomState(43)
a_rho_by_format.caveat_to_state: n = 10 per format; the AUROC values carry their own two-way bootstrap uncertainty (within-checkpoint SD about 0.03) which the checkpoint bootstrap ignores

b_partner_adjusted.systems: b2mixed BiomedBERT (seed mean of seeds 42, 1, 2, 3, 4, ood_empty / oodold_empty), the 20 Amendment 7 panel checkpoints (runs/preds a7-panel-*, variants marker and pair, ood_empty / oodold_empty, one seed each), Qwen2.5-7B names only (llm-qwen-names), DrugBank lookup
b_partner_adjusted.cohorts: Novel (438 rows, 48 drugs) and Older-clean (1832 rows, 128 drugs), tier A
b_partner_adjusted.scale: logit of P(interaction) for models, the 0/1 listing for DrugBank, as in experiment 7
b_partner_adjusted.partner_prior: label-free: baselines.Context.partner_prior, the share of vocabulary Drug Interactions sections (excluding the partner's own RxCUI) that name the partner; feature iii2 of scripts/amend7_cpu_exp7_below_chance.py
b_partner_adjusted.adjustment: within-drug residualization of experiment 7 (partial): demean score and prior within OOD drug, regress, subtract slope times prior from the score; adjusted within-drug AUROC on the residual
b_partner_adjusted.intervals: two-way cluster bootstrap over OOD drugs and partner drugs, amend7_cpu_common.paired_draws, 1000 draws, seed 1042 Novel and 42 Older-clean, raw and adjusted in the same draws; the paired difference adjusted minus raw is reported
b_partner_adjusted.tetrad: doubly matched tetrad AUROC of post7_common.tetrad_design on the additive scale, two-way weights of post7_common.scheme_weights with the same seeds; values for systems already in results/revision/post7/partner.json are checked against that file
b_partner_adjusted.reproduction_checks: b2mixed, Qwen and DrugBank adjusted values must equal experiment 7 iii2 partialled values to 3 decimals; tetrad values must equal post7/partner.json

m3b.drugbank_source: ~/Downloads/drugbank_all_full_database.xml.zip; version and exported-on read from the drugbank root element and written to every output
m3b.resolution: the experiment 5 rule (scripts/amend7_cpu_exp5_dissociation.py resolve, equivalent to ddiood.drugbank.validate): names plus RxNorm normalized and canonicalized forms from artifacts/vocab/drug_lookup.json; listed if either drug's DrugBank interaction list names the other
m3b.a_random_pairs: the SemEval vocabulary is the 992 keys of artifacts/vocab/drug_lookup.json; 10000 unordered pairs of two keys with different RxCUI drawn uniformly with replacement of pairs (numpy RandomState(1)); primary rate = listed / pairs with at least one drug resolved (the exp5 'resolvable' denominator); also listed / all and listed / both resolved; Wilson 95% intervals. Secondary: the same with one key per RxCUI (alphabetically first key). Compared with SemEval test negatives and positives on the same denominators, with and without self pairs
m3b.b_by_source: DrugBank lookup pooled AUROC on SemEval test against binary SemEval labels, by corpus folder (DrugBank = DDI-DrugBank documents, MedLine = DDI-MedLine abstracts), all pairs and without self pairs (case and space normalised same name), unresolvable counted as not listed, sentence-cluster bootstrap 1000 draws seed 42 (ev.boot_auroc)
m3b.c_string_match: non_di_label_string_match pooled AUROC with intervals copied from results/corrected/baselines.json (two-way cluster bootstrap, seed 42); additionally within-drug AUROC on Novel and Older-clean from results/corrected/baseline_scores.json with paired_draws two-way intervals (1000, seeds 1042 / 42)
m3b.d_subgroups: algebraic decomposition: for a 0/1 score AUROC = 0.5 (1 + TPR - FPR); report TPR and FPR per subgroup and the subgroup weights among positives and among negatives that produce the pooled value, for all 2810 pairs and without self pairs

m8.reconcile: convert the sensitivity half-width / SD to the post7 ratio by dividing by 1.645 (the stored halfwidth90_over_nominal field), restrict to matching cells (two-way bootstrap, tier A, each cohort), and list every remaining difference in definitions, scenarios, replicate counts, seeds and SD estimator
m8.collect: for the writer, copy without recomputation: Bayesian ROPE (post7/calibration.json bayes, H1 tier A primary and secondary), one-way drug and partner-only bootstrap rows (post7/calibration.json intervals), coverage of partner-only (post7/coverage.json), spike-in kappa rule threshold and observed decision (spikein/spikein.json), with the criteria file of each

m10.metric: SemEval 2013 DDI standard: micro-averaged F1 over the four positive classes mechanism, effect, advise, int (sklearn f1_score labels [1, 2, 3, 4], average micro) on test_sentence 5-class argmax predictions
m10.models: b2sentence and b2mixed for biomedbert, bertbase (seeds 42, 1, 2, 3, 4) and biobert (seed 42 only); also the 20 panel checkpoints (test_sentence) as a secondary table
m10.aggregation: per seed, then mean, SD (ddof 1), min and max over seeds; sentence-cluster bootstrap 95% interval for each seed (1000, seed 42)
m10.official_set_bound: a second column treats the 2906 official test pairs that the repository does not score (entity types brand and group) as predicted false, which gives the score these predictions would receive on the 5716-pair official set; it is a lower bound for a model that scored those pairs, not an estimate
m10.published: Gu et al. 2021 (ACM HEALTH, arXiv 2007.15779) Table 6: PubMedBERT 82.36, BioBERT 80.88, BERT uncased 80.04, micro F1, BLURB DDI test 5716 pairs; the comparison is stated as not like-for-like (different train split, entity types, preprocessing)

m9.panel: each of the 20 panel checkpoints on SemEval test_sentence and on Novel and Older-clean (ood_empty / oodold_empty): confusion (binary argmax != false), F1, all-positive F1 on the same rows, MCC, balanced accuracy, AUPRC (average precision of P(interaction)), prevalence
m9.h2: b2sentence and b2masked BiomedBERT, seeds 42, 1, 2, 3, 4, on test_sentence and test_masked: the same metrics per seed, plus the preregistered seed-mean masked/sentence F1 ratio reproduced from decisions.json

m7.statistic: pooled AUROC of b2mixed BiomedBERT ood_empty P(interaction) averaged over seeds 1, 2, 3, 4, 42 on Novel (438 pairs), as in the preregistration's primary endpoint
m7.intervals: drug-cluster bootstrap (the preregistered one, ev.boot_auroc groups = OOD drug, 1000 draws, seed 42): 90% and 95% percentile intervals and p_TOST against [0.40, 0.60]; the two-way interval alongside; must reproduce 0.529 [0.457, 0.608]

rules: no hypothesis decision is changed; outputs are descriptive; any reproduction mismatch is reported, not hidden
